views.name: artist_total_sales
views.body_sql:
SELECT
    a.ArtistId AS artist_id,
    SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_amount
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId
views.description: total amount spent per artist across all album purchases

views.name: filtered_customer_purchases
views.body_sql:
SELECT c.CustomerId AS customer_id, i.InvoiceId AS purchase_id, c.FirstName AS customer_first_name, i.Total AS purchase_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
views.description: joins customer first names, purchase amounts, and artist sales aggregates, applying filters for the top artist and purchase amount threshold
